title: Etale surjections over finite strictly henselian base algebras admit sections
statement: Let H be a commutative strictly henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], A a commutative H-algebra finite as an H-module, and E a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For every etale morphism p:E→Spec A [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] surjective on points, there is sigma:Spec A→E with sigma;p=id. No finiteness of p is required; A=0 is allowed.

proof.text: Use the finite henselian algebra decomposition to write A as a finite product of henselian local H-algebras B_j with local structure maps and finite residue field extensions. Each residue field is separably closed by Algebra.IsAlgebraic.isSepClosed, since that of H is separably closed.

For each j, pull p back along Spec B_j→Spec A. Surjectivity provides a point over the closed point. Apply exists_section_of_etale_of_isStrictlyHenselianLocalRing, and compose the resulting section with the first pullback projection to get s_j; p = Spec B_j→Spec A.

The finite-product spectrum is the coproduct of the factor spectra (sigmaSpec is an isomorphism). Compose the inverse of this isomorphism with Sigma.desc s_j. Sigma.hom_ext proves its composite with p is identity. The same formula includes the empty product.
